mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan-origin document: notarization before a Taiwan district court notary or licensed notary; then authentication by the Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs Department of Consular Affairs; then consular legalization by the destination-state embassy or consulate in Taipei. Hague Apostille is not available for Taiwan because Taiwan is not a contracting party to the Apostille Convention; use apostille only for PRC-origin documents and never chain apostille with consular legalization.

Notarize at a Taiwan notary; authenticate through Taiwan MOFA Department of Consular Affairs; then legalize at the destination-state consulate. For PRC-issued counterparts eligible for the Hague Convention, notarize at a PRC notary and apply for apostille at the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs; do not add consular legalization to the apostille.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the joint venture shareholders and the Taiwan incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the resolution is signed in mainland China, notarize the signatures at a PRC Notary Public and obtain a Hague Apostille from the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs for an Apostille-convention destination. If signed in Taiwan, use Taiwan notarization followed by Taiwan MOFA authentication and destination-state consular legalization. The two authentication paths are parallel and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Taiwan notary public and the incorporators
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan-origin charter: notarization by Taiwan notary; authentication by Taiwan MOFA; consular legalization by the destination-state consulate. A Hague Apostille may only be used for PRC-origin charter versions, and only when the destination state is a member of the Apostille Convention. Never use apostille and consular legalization in the same chain.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Taiwanese bank holding the sponsor's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank branch manager signature notarized before a Taiwan notary; authentication by Taiwan MOFA; consular legalization by the destination-state consulate. Apostille cannot be used because this is a Taiwan-issued banking document; if a mainland Chinese bank issues the reference letter for a supporting parent, the PRC notary plus apostille route applies for Apostille states.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening shall cover all shareholders, directors, beneficial owners, authorized signatories, and counterparties against the OFAC SDN and non-SDN Consolidated Sanctions Lists, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI Consolidated List, Taiwan FSC designated persons list and Central Bank Taiwan AML/CFT sanctions list, and the PRC MOFCOM/MEES sanctions and export-control lists. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory because captive reinsurance is medium-risk; the applicant must document source of wealth using audited financial statements, bank statements, tax returns, and corporate registers, and must refresh all screening before each transaction and at least every 90 days, retaining records for five years after account closure.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Department of Commercial Affairs Company and Business Scope Pre-Examination System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official company name must be in traditional Chinese characters; an English name is auxiliary and must be a faithful semantic or phonetic transliteration. The name must follow the four-tier structure: distinctive trade name + business scope descriptor + organization type + proprietary legal-critical token. Phonetic transliterations must use standard Mandarin pronunciation, avoid identical or confusingly similar names already on the MOEA register, and must not imply a governmental or financial function unless authorized.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended once by filing with MOEA before expiry when the FSC captive reinsurance license application is pending. Upon rejection, the applicant should file a written objection with MOEA within 15 days; alternatively, within 30 days of service, file an administrative appeal with the Executive Yuan under the Administrative Appeal Act. The appeal must include the rejected name, proposed alternative names, the amended business scope, and arguments establishing distinctiveness and compatibility with the Insurance Act and FSC captives rules. The applicant may simultaneously file a fresh reservation with alternative names to avoid delay. If the administrative appeal is dismissed, administrative litigation may be filed in the Taipei High Administrative Court within two months of service.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible for this captive reinsurance SPV. The Taiwan Insurance Act, FSC Regulations for Captive Insurance Companies, and local tax registration rules require a physical registered office in Taiwan with a local senior manager, permanent and exclusive lease, physical books and records, board minutes held at a location accessible for inspection, actuarial and underwriting systems, and a bank account for segregated underwriting reserves. Regulators and banks will reject a postal-only address because it lacks commercial substance and fails the economic real activity test for the captive reinsurance license and the corresponding tax incentives.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: High, approximately 70% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission or the local tax authority within the first 24 months after licensing. Checklist: (i) verify office signage and directory listing; (ii) inspect the original lease and utility bills; (iii) confirm at least one senior manager is physically present; (iv) examine the board resolution book and minutes; (v) review underwriting policies, reserves, and ledger entries; (vi) inspect bank statements evidencing segregated underwriting reserve wires; (vii) confirm AML/CFT policies and training logs; (viii) inspect actuarial and solvency reports; (ix) verify data storage and IT systems; (x) interview the UBO on the intended business plan and capital adequacy.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act as substantially consolidated, particularly Articles 1, 128, 129, 156, 161, 171, 172 and 387; Taiwan Insurance Act Articles 40 to 44; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals; Organic Act of the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Executive Yuan, Taiwan, operating through the MOEA Company Registration Online Application System.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation and the corresponding Company Registration Application prescribed under Article 387 of the Taiwan Company Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under the Taiwan Company Act there is no fixed statutory minimum paid-in capital for a company limited by shares. However, the FSC, acting under the Insurance Act and captive reinsurance regulations, will impose a prudential minimum capital requirement and, where required, a guarantee deposit based on the scale and risk profile of the proposed captive reinsurance program. All initial paid-up capital, including any foreign-invested capital, must be remitted to Taiwan and deposited into a blocked escrow bank account for which a bank capital verification certificate must be issued. The blocked funds may not be disbursed until the FSC operating license is granted and all conditions of the FSC establishment authorization have been satisfied. Any foreign investment must also be reported to the Central Bank and approved under the investment approval framework.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME]

WHEREAS, the initial Board of Directors has been lawfully convened with all directors present in person or by proxy;
WHEREAS, [COMPANY NAME] is to be incorporated as a company limited by shares in Taiwan for the purpose of acting as a captive reinsurance special purpose vehicle for the risks of the parent group;
WHEREAS, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) has granted conditional establishment authorization for the proposed captive reinsurance business;
WHEREAS, the Board must adopt all resolutions necessary to complete incorporation, capital subscription, banking setup, registered office, and appointment of statutory officers.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED:

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The subscription schedule presented to the Board, setting forth the identity of each subscriber and the number and par value of shares subscribed, is hereby ratified in full. The initial paid-in capital of [amount] represented by [number] ordinary shares with par value of [amount] per share has been fully subscribed and paid before or upon this meeting. The Board confirms that the aggregate paid-in amount has been received into the capital subscription account and instructs the Chief Financial Officer to transfer the funds into a blocked escrow account at the Company's designated bank. Such account shall not be disbursed until the FSC has issued the final operating permit and all conditions to the establishment authorization have been satisfied.

2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The Board designates [bank name] and [bank name], or such other banks as the Executive Officers may select with prior Board approval, as the depositaries of the Company. The Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and Corporate Secretary, acting in any two-person combination, are hereby authorized, jointly, to sign for and on behalf of the Company all account-opening documents, checks, wire transfer orders, foreign exchange applications, letters of instruction, and any banking or treasury instruments necessary for the underwriting reserve wire and SWIFT payment rails, in compliance with the Insurance Act, the Central Bank foreign exchange regulations, and FSC internal-control directives.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered office of the Company shall be at [address], Taiwan. The Corporate Secretary is directed to execute or cause to be executed the office lease, to accept service of process, to post the corporate nameplate, and to keep the statutory registers, seal, books, and accounting records at that address. Any change of registered office shall be filed with the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, and, if applicable, with the FSC.

4. STATUTORY OFFICERS. The following persons are appointed as statutory officers of the Company: [name] as Chief Executive Officer and President; [name] as Chief Financial Officer; and [name] as Corporate Secretary and Chief Compliance Officer. Each officer shall execute a formal acceptance of office, submit required certifications of good character and experience to the FSC, take an oath of confidentiality, and perform all duties required by law and by the Company's internal governance documents.

5. POST-MEETING DIRECTIONS. All officers are instructed to proceed immediately with the FSC license, company registration, tax registration, labor registration, bank-account activation, and any necessary notarization and apostille processes. The officers are authorized to retain attorneys, accountants, actuaries, and notaries and to execute such incidental agreements as are necessary to complete the incorporation and licensing. This Resolution is effective immediately and may be filed in any public registry or produced to any bank, auditor, or regulatory authority.

UNANIMOUSLY PASSED this [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Preliminary FSC Authorization for Captive Reinsurance SPV
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC) in consultation with the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), Insurance Bureau; online submission through the MOEAIC foreign investment portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before filing any incorporation papers, the joint-venture investors must obtain foreign investment approval from the Investment Commission if any non-Taiwan enterprise participates. Submit a notarized application package containing the joint-venture contract, captive reinsurance feasibility study, capital-source statement, and draft Articles of Incorporation. The applicant should simultaneously request a preliminary FSC no-objection letter for the proposed captive reinsurance activity, since company registration cannot be completed without prior FSC establishment authorization. All foreign-language documents must be translated with notarized translator certification. The competent authority will review shareholding structure, beneficial ownership, financial soundness, and the special-purpose-vehicle nature.
required_dossiers: Duly completed MOEAIC foreign investment application form
Notarized certificate of incorporation and good standing of each investing entity
Signed joint-venture contract and shareholders' agreement
Captive reinsurance business plan and feasibility study
Notarized source-of-funds statements and bank references
Draft Articles of Incorporation
Power of attorney to local counsel, if any
FSC preliminary authorization request and supporting risk-management plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a query or suspension, the applicant has 30 days to file a supplemental statement and corrective documents. A formal adverse decision may be challenged by administrative petition to MOEA within 30 days and thereafter by judicial administrative appeal before the Taipei High Administrative Court if necessary. Alternatively, the parties may restructure shareholding percentages and resubmit without prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: FSC Captive Reinsurance Establishment License Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The FSC license application is the controlling regulatory step for a captive reinsurance SPV. File the official establishment application under the Insurance Act with the proposed company's Articles of Incorporation, risk underwriting methodology, reinsurance program, capital adequacy projection, solvency control procedures, AML/CFT policy, actuarial opinion, and corporate governance charter. The founders must demonstrate that the SPV will be engaged exclusively in captive reinsurance for its parent group and maintain ring-fenced reserves. The FSC may impose conditions, including minimum capital levels, director suitability requirements, and reserve or guarantee deposit requirements. After approval, the FSC will issue a conditional permit or establishment authorization that must be submitted to the company registry; the final operating license becomes effective only after company registration and condition compliance.
required_dossiers: FSC prescribed establishment application form
Articles of Incorporation and internal governance rules
Captive reinsurance plan and business model description
Financial projections and capital adequacy report for the first three years
AML/CFT policy and risk management framework
Biographic and qualification declarations of proposed directors and officers
Actuarial certification of premium and reserve adequacy
Shareholder registers and ultimate beneficial ownership statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FSC requires amendments, the applicant must respond within two months with a supplemental package. If the FSC denies the application, the investors may request reconsideration, then file an administrative appeal under the Administrative Appeal Act, and ultimately pursue administrative litigation. Amendment of the corporate scope or capital plan may be required before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) via the MOEA Company Registration Online Application System.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving FSC conditional establishment authorization, apply for company registration as a Taiwan company limited by shares. Use the MOEA online one-stop application. Submit the Articles of Incorporation, subscription schedule, bank capital verification certificate for the blocked paid-in capital account, registered-office lease and landlord consent, list of directors and statutory officers with signed consents, and the FSC authorization letter. The application must be signed by the Corporate Secretary or a licensed certified public accountant. The MOEA will issue the Company Registration Certificate and the unified tax identification number as part of the one-stop service. Upon this issuance, the company acquires separate legal personality and may open final bank accounts and execute contracts, subject to the FSC operating permit.
required_dossiers: FSC establishment authorization letter
Notarized or certified Articles of Incorporation
Capital verification certificate issued by the escrow bank
Subscription schedule and capital payment receipts
Registered-office lease or ownership title with landlord consent
Consents to appointment of directors and statutory officers
Photocopies or identification credentials of directors and officers
MOEA incorporation application form signed by all subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MOEA issues a rectification notice, the applicant must correct the defect within 15 days; otherwise the filing is rejected. The applicant may re-file immediately after correction. If the rejection is contested, the applicant may file a formal petition to the MOEA within 30 days and thereafter an administrative action. FSC-imposed conditions are not waivable by the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Labor, and Office Compliance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Regional National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance; Bureau of Labor Insurance; National Health Insurance Administration; local municipal labor affairs office and fire department for office fire-safety inspection.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete post-registration filings using the company registration certificate and tax ID. Register as a profit-seeking enterprise for corporate income tax and uniform invoicing. For a captive reinsurer, apply for financial-institution business tax in addition to standard tax registration and obtain payroll withholding registration. If the SPV hires staff in Taiwan, submit labor insurance, employment insurance, and national health insurance registration within statutory deadlines. The registered office must hold a current fire-safety inspection certificate under the Fire Services Act and a structural or building safety certificate under the Building Act. No industrial EIA or environmental permit is required for an administrative office used solely for captive reinsurance operations.
required_dossiers: Company registration certificate
FSC operating license or establishment authorization
Articles of Incorporation
Lease contract and building safety inspection certificate
Tax and payroll setup application forms
Director and employee identification documents
Bank confirmation of paid-in capital account
Compliance officer AML registration declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority rejects or queries a filing, a corrective amendment may be filed with the regional National Taxation Bureau, and any assessed penalty may be appealed through the Ministry of Finance. Late labor registrations are cured by expedited supplemental filing and payment of any late fees; formal labor disputes go to the relevant labor authority or court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Final FSC Operating Permit Activation and Commencement of Captive Reinsurance Business
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), Insurance Bureau, in coordination with the Central Bank of Taiwan for foreign-exchange settlement.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After MOEA registration, return to the FSC for final verification. The FSC will confirm that all pre-conditions have been satisfied, including paid-in capital deposit, guarantee deposit if imposed, approval of directors and actuaries, and filing of internal-control and compliance manuals. It will then issue the final captive reinsurance operating permit, authorizing the SPV to underwrite and assume reinsurance risks exclusively for the designated parent group. The SPV shall execute captive reinsurance agreements, issue risk participations, and maintain ring-fenced reserves in accordance with FSC reporting standards. Premiums and reserves shall flow through bank SWIFT and wire rails with complete foreign-exchange reporting. If no industrial or warehousing facility is established, no Civil Defense fire permit or EIA approval is applicable.
required_dossiers: MOEA Company Registration Certificate
FSC conditional authorization and condition-compliance report
Proof of guarantee deposit if imposed
Final capital account certificate from the bank
Internal-control and compliance manuals
AML officer appointment certificate
Captive reinsurance program policies and sample agreements
Banking facility agreements and wire-format instructions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FSC declines to issue the final operating permit, the company may submit all missing evidence within 60 days. A formal denial may be contested by administrative appeal to the FSC and thereafter by administrative judicial review. While any appeal is pending, no underwriting may be conducted.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), Insurance Bureau for the financial operating license; no industrial or manufacturing licensing board is implicated for ISIC 6512 captive reinsurance SPV; any local office fire-safety inspection is administered by the local fire department under the National Fire Agency.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Captive Reinsurance Operating Permit, including the establishment authorization issued under Article 40 of the Taiwan Insurance Act; no general industrial operating license is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration (EPA), Executive Yuan, Taiwan - Not Applicable for ISIC 6512.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable - the SPV is a non-manufacturing captive reinsurance entity with no physical production, chemical process, assembly, or warehousing footprint, and is therefore exempt from Environmental Impact Assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - no wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, hazardous waste generation, or stationary-source combustion exists. Municipal office waste shall be disposed in accordance with local solid-waste and recycling bylaws; any future physical installation would trigger a new environmental screening and EIA assessment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable to industrial Civil Defense fire permits; however, any staffed office must maintain a current fire-safety inspection certificate under the Fire Services Act and a structural or building safety certificate under the Building Act. The employer must comply with the Occupational Safety and Health Act by conducting hazard assessments, maintaining evacuation routes, fire extinguishers, first-aid provisions, and sanitary facilities. If a physical plant or warehouse is ever established, a new Civil Defense and environmental clearance process will be triggered.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (R.O.C.); field administration is handled by the National Taxation Bureau for the jurisdiction where the captive reinsurance SPV has its registered office. Online electronic portal: Taiwan Tax E-Portal, https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident owner must first obtain foreign investment approval from the Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, and incorporate the Taiwan entity or branch with the Department of Commerce. The Taiwan tax identification number is the Unified Business Number (UBN), which also functions as the VAT registration number. The UBN application is filed with the competent National Taxation Bureau before business commencement, using the online Business Tax Registration service or by written application at the local tax office. The filing package must include: authenticated certificate of incorporation and articles of incorporation of the foreign shareholder; foreign-investment approval letter; board resolution appointing the Taiwan responsible person; a registered-office address proof and lease contract; the Ministry of Economic Affairs company or branch registration certificate; and, where applicable, the Insurance Act license for captive reinsurance operations. The National Taxation Bureau verifies the application, assigns the eight-digit UBN, and issues the business-tax registration certificate. A Taiwan subsidiary receives a new UBN; a branch is registered under the same UBN as the head office. Non-resident enterprises without a Taiwan branch and supplying services into Taiwan must also complete VAT registration and obtain a UBN through a tax agent before collecting Taiwanese business tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Taiwan tax law does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election; a Taiwan-incorporated captive reinsurance SPV is an entity-level taxpayer and must file corporate income tax separately. VAT grouping is unavailable.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Business Tax (VAT) under the Business Tax Act, with special non-value-added business-tax rules applicable to insurance operations for domestic source transactions
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold: business-tax registration is mandatory before commencing taxable sales in Taiwan. A non-resident supplier of cross-border digital services has a NT$480,000 per-calendar-year Taiwanese-source sales threshold, but the captive reinsurance SPV, if resident or carrying on business in Taiwan, is registrable from day one.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan mandates uniform invoice issuance. VAT taxpayers must adopt electronic invoices and transmit the e-invoice XML data to the Ministry of Finance E-Invoice Integrated Service Platform through the XML TurnKey interface or direct API integration. Retail (B2C) e-invoice data must be uploaded generally within 48 hours of issuance; business-to-business (B2B) e-invoice data is transmitted before the quarterly business-tax filing deadline and matched to the counterparty account. Taiwan does not use physical fiscal stamping; anti-fraud control relies on mandatory QR codes, sequential invoice numbering, random-code authentication, and duplicate or abnormal-sales-pattern detection by the tax authority. Failure to integrate or transmit e-invoices is treated as failure to issue a uniform invoice and is subject to a separate fine.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act, a 0% rate applies to goods physically exported from Taiwan and to services supplied to foreign enterprises or individuals where the services are used outside Taiwan and the consideration is in foreign currency. A captive reinsurance SPV qualifies for 0% only where the ceding insurer is a foreign (non-Taiwan) entity, the reinsured risks are located outside Taiwan, the reinsurance contract is performed offshore in the sense that no insurance or reinsurance service is consumed inside Taiwan, and the premium and claims are settled in foreign currency through a Taiwanese foreign-exchange bank account. Domestic risks ceded by a Taiwan insurer are domestic taxable supplies at 5%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration processed by the Directorate General of Customs, Ministry of Finance (for goods movements), including the export e-reference number, container and cargo details, and confirmed export port or airport.
Commercial invoice and packing list supporting the invoice value declared to customs.
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (or express consignment note) showing physical movement from Taiwan customs territory to the overseas buyer.

Inward Foreign Exchange Remittance Certificate or the bank settlement voucher issued by a designated foreign-exchange bank proving actual repatriation of export proceeds into a Taiwan foreign-exchange account.

For captive reinsurance service exports: the signed reinsurance treaty or contract, ceding bordereaux, actuarial premium calculation, proof that the underlying risk is located outside Taiwan, and the foreign-exchange receipt record for premiums.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Taxation Bureau may reopen the seven-year statutory assessment period. If the 0% export claim is not supported by the customs declaration, lading documents, contract, and foreign-exchange receipt, the revenue is reclassified as domestic taxable and assessed at 5% VAT, with overdue surcharge and late-filing penalties. False documents, fake reinsurance risk, circular foreign-exchange remittances, or misrepresented offshore risks are treated as tax evasion under the Business Tax Act Article 51, which may subject the taxpayer to a fine of up to five times the tax evaded, plus criminal referral for responsible persons under the Tax Collection Act; the VAT registration may also be cancelled and unreported periods adjusted.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), operating under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The People's Republic of China maintains a managed floating exchange rate regime with current account convertibility and partial capital account liberalisation. For a Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture engaged in captive reinsurance, ordinary operating receipts (premiums, investment income, claims reimbursements) are treated as current account items and may be freely converted upon submission of authentic underlying documentation. Profit remittances and dividend distributions to the Taiwan-based or other foreign shareholders are permissible after corporate tax clearance, provided that audited financial statements and board-resolved dividend declarations are filed with the settlement bank. Capital account movements, including foreign direct investment capital injection and external borrowings, remain subject to SAFE registration, special-purpose account usage, and real-transaction verification. The captive reinsurance SPV, as a licensed financial institution, must obtain prior SAFE approval for any outward remittance of reinsurance premiums, claims payments, or statutory capital deductions beyond the regular current account framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the SAFE Circular on Optimising Foreign Exchange Administration (汇发〔2019〕28号) and the Goods Trade Foreign Exchange Administration Guidelines, China no longer imposes mandatory conversion (surrender) of export proceeds. Exporters may retain foreign currency earnings in designated current account settlement accounts or convert them into RMB at will. Export receipts must nevertheless be repatriated to China through a domestic banking channel within 90 days of the customs declaration date, unless an extension is registered in the Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System. For the specific captive reinsurance business, premium and claim collections from overseas are classified under service trade and must be reported under the Service Trade Foreign Exchange Administration Framework, with no mandatory conversion ratio but with full documentary verification of reinsurance treaties, bordereaux, and settlement statements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (中国工商银行)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low - Offshore fintech EMIs (e.g., Wise, Revolut Business, MultiPass) have no legal capacity to open domestic Chinese bank accounts or provide local IBANs denominated in CNY. Under PRC foreign exchange regulations, all corporate foreign currency receipts and payments must route through SAFE-licensed domestic banks. Offshore EMIs cannot act as the primary clearing rail for the captive reinsurance SPV because they do not fall within SAFE's supervisory framework and cannot obtain the necessary capital account or current account reporting codes. They may only serve as supplementary global treasury concentration tools for non-China settled jurisdictions, subject to the entity's internal treasury policy and without touching the China onshore banking layer.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The legal representative or an authorised director of the Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture must appear in person at the domestic commercial bank branch for the initial onboarding interview. A video-conference conference is generally insufficient for first-time account opening at leading tier-1 banks, especially for entities with foreign shareholders. The bank will conduct physical ID verification, board resolution inspection, and a beneficial ownership interview. For the Taiwan-based shareholder, the bank may accept notarised power of attorney and corporate documents certified by the Taiwan court or a PRC-licensed notary, but the mainland-appointed CFO or general manager is still required for the physical interview. Some banks offer remote document submission for post-account-opening changes, but the initial open mandates face-to-face attendance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity resulting from multi-tiered cross-border shareholding between mainland China and Taiwan, coupled with a captive reinsurance SPV structure and possible intermediate holding companies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A comprehensive corporate chart; articles of association; full shareholder register with direct share percentages; sworn individual or ultimate corporate ownership declaration forms; audited financial statements of the immediate and upstream shareholders; certified identity proofs of all directors and ultimate beneficial owners; bank reference letters from the shareholders' domiciled banks; and a written explanation of the SPV's risk-bearing role within the group's internal transfer pricing framework.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The reinsurance licence itself and associated premium flows may be mischaracterised as high-risk insurance money laundering activity, especially if counterparties include unlicensed reinsurance brokers or jurisdictions with weaker AML regimes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid PRC insurance regulator licence for captive reinsurance; board-approval minutes authorising the captive reinsurance contracts; executed reinsurance agreements with each ceding insurer; detailed bordereaux for all inward premiums and outward claims; source-of-funds evidence for initial capital contribution; internal AML/CFT policy compliant with the Insurance Law and the PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law; onboarding due-diligence reports for each counterparty; and a periodic transaction monitoring review report issued within the last 12 months.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan-based shareholder or any non-PRC foreign investor will inject paid-in capital via SWIFT MT103/202 to the captive SPV's dedicated FDI Capital Account at a SAFE-licensed domestic bank. The remitting bank must include the following wire purpose code in field 70 (Remittance Information): '701010 - 外方以现汇投入的资本金' (Foreign investor cash capital contribution). Before receiving the wire, the SPV must have completed SAFE Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) registration through the receiving bank, obtained the FDI business registration certificate, and furnished the bank with the unique FDI verification code. The receiving bank verifies the remitter name, transaction narration, and substance of the underlying contract and business licence. Once credited, the capital may be retained in foreign currency or settled into RMB at the prevailing exchange rate. Any conversion and use of the RMB proceeds must comply with the negative list and the operational scope stipulated in the business licence. Actual payment from the capital account to third parties requires submission of payment instruction with supporting vouchers (purchase order, construction contract, reinsurance reserve funding agreement) to the bank for authenticity review.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outward disbursements out of the SPV's current account, the primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for telegraphic transfers under the transaction's underlying commercial or reinsurance contract. The remitting bank executes the transfer only after examination of the relevant contract, invoice, and, where applicable, customs declaration. For reinsurance claims and premium cessions, the SPV will present a settlement statement or bordereau together with the reinsurance treaty. If the market custom requires documentary credit, a commercial letter of credit (L/C) may be established using the domestic bank's issuance facility, with SWIFT MT700 series messages for negotiation. For high-value or scheduled reinsurance settlements, the SPV may combine multiple transfers into a single bulk payment instruction, but each underlying claim must be enumerated in the remittance detail. All outgoing foreign exchange payments are subject to SAFE monitoring and must be accurately categorised under the International Investment Position and Trade (IIP) statistical reporting codes, most commonly '222010' for reinsurance premium remittances and '222020' for claims settlements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward foreign exchange outright contracts (交割远期外汇合约) based on real and documented current account exposure, such as expected premium inflows or approved capital outflows, allowed via the domestic banking system.

Offshore deliverable NDF (无本金交割远期外汇) in the RMB market, permitted only for qualified onshore corporates through a SAFE-authorised bank where the bank offsets underlying exposure with an offshore counterparty; limited to genuine hedging and subject to stringent documentary evidence of the underlying cash flow and repatriation scheme.

FX cross-currency swaps (外汇掉期) that convert fixed-rate premium receipts or pre-agreed capital contributions into matching foreign currency streams, executed under the ISDA or NAFMII master agreement and booked with the onshore settlement bank.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting of Shareholders: adoption of the business report, CPA-audited financial statements, and profit distribution or loss-offset proposal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commercial Affairs; meeting minutes and resolutions submitted through the MOEA Company Registration E-System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six (6) months after the close of each fiscal year (calendar-year company: by 30 June of the following year); alternate fiscal year permitted only with MOEA approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory fine on responsible persons plus MOEA order to convene a remedial meeting within a fixed period; persistent failure may be treated as inactive operation and can culminate in an administrative command-dissolution order under Company Act Article 10

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual electronic declaration of directors, supervisors, managers, and shareholders holding 10% or more of shares (Company Act Article 22-1; non-public company UBO-type disclosure)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOEA Company Registration One-Stop Service (electronic Article 22-1 declaration platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 March and 31 March, reporting the register position as at 31 December of the prior year; any mid-year share transfer or management change must be separately reported within 15 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of NT$50,000-NT$1,000,000 for failure to report or for false reporting; MOEA sets a rectification deadline and may impose repeat fines per period; no automatic strike-off, but cumulative breach supports a command-dissolution action

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registry return of audited annual financial statements and recordal of annual meeting resolutions (including dividend appropriation) in the corporate registration file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after the shareholders' meeting approving the statements (calendar-year company: generally by 15 July); statements must remain available at the head office during the statutory pre-meeting inspection window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines on the responsible person under Company Act Articles 20-21 enforcement rules and a MOEA-imposed correction period; default undermines clean registry standing required for subsequent filings and is aggregated into dissolution criteria

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual FSC regulatory return for the licensed captive reinsurance (insurance enterprise) business: audited financial statements, business report, property list, and solvency/RBC schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three (3) months after fiscal year-end (calendar-year company: 31 March) per the Insurance Act annual reporting obligation; CPA-audited statements must accompany the filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: FSC corrective order with a fixed submission deadline and administrative fines under the Insurance Act escalating for repeat breaches; serious or persistent default may trigger suspension or revocation of the reinsurance license

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: FSC-licensed insurance and reinsurance enterprises are unconditionally subject to annual independent CPA audit under the Insurance Act and FSC regulations regardless of size; additionally, under Company Act Article 20 and MOEA enforcement rules, any non-public company with paid-in capital exceeding NT$30 million (approx. USD 0.95 million) must procure CPA-audited and certified financial statements. The JV captive reinsurer will normally exceed the capital threshold and is in any event audit-mandatory by reason of its FSC license status.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Business Entity Accounting Act governs statutory bookkeeping; financial statements follow Taiwan-IFRS (ROC GAAP converged to IFRS as endorsed by the FSC). Insurance enterprises file statutory returns in FSC-prescribed formats, applying FSC-mandated IFRS accounting for reinsurance reserves and IFRS 17 transition schedules; accounting vouchers are retained at least 5 years and accounting books and financial reports at least 10 years.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Company Act Article 22-1 and the MOEA's Implementing Regulations on Data Declaration, no annual on-site stamping of the register is required. The JV must (i) update the shareholders' register promptly upon each share transfer (recording transferor, transferee, date, type and number of shares), (ii) report any consequent 10% or more shareholding change to MOEA within 15 days of the event, and (iii) complete the consolidated annual electronic declaration between 1 March and 31 March reflecting the year-end ownership position. The annual declaration, not a separate UBO return, is the statutory confirmation event for a Taiwanese non-public company.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholder roster) maintained at the head office and open to statutory inspection
Register of Directors (directors and supervisors list)
Minute Book (shareholders' meeting minutes and board meeting minutes)
Share transfer ledger and underlying transfer instruments

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900 - USD 2,500 per annum (registered office address, corporate secretary/agent, and MOEA e-filing support)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 15,000 - USD 40,000 per annum (CPA audit of a licensed captive reinsurance entity, inclusive of FSC reporting schedules)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying small and medium profit-seeking enterprises may apply a reduced CIT rate on the first tranche of taxable income; R&D tax credits, investment tax credits, and beneficial deduction for certain reinsurance reserve builds reduce the effective rate. The surtax on undistributed retained earnings adds 5% at corporate level, yielding a combined top effective rate as high as 25% before credits. Large enterprises are also subject to the 12% alternative minimum tax (AMT) on tax-preferred income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Settlement Return (營利事業所得稅結算申報書) — filed electronically via the Ministry of Finance’s Electronic Tax Filing Service (電子申報繳稅服務網) or physically at the National Taxation Bureau responsible for the JV’s registered domicile. Insurance and reinsurance companies must be audited by a certified public accountant.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending 31 December, the return must be filed from 1 May through 31 May of the following year. For any other approved fiscal year-end, the return is due within four months after the close of the fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1: 營利事業統一編號 (Tax ID)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter the eight-digit Taiwan tax identification number assigned to the captive reinsurance SPV.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Taiwan-incorporated JV itself must complete this field with its Taiwan tax ID. Foreign non-resident shareholders are not entered in this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report all reinsurance premiums assumed, including reinstatement premiums, reduced by reinsurance ceded to permissible overseas reinsurers. Premiums are recorded on accrual basis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident offshore captive maintaining neither a Taiwanese branch nor PE, offshore premium income is not subject to Taiwan CIT. If a Taiwan branch exists, gross Taiwan-source premiums belong in this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 12: Insurance reserves and actuarial provisions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct unearned premium reserve, unexpired risk reserve, claims reserve, reserve for outstanding losses, and equalisation reserves calculated according to the Insurance Act and FSC actuarial guidelines.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident branches must demonstrate that reserves and related assets are segregated in Taiwan; head-office expense allocations into this line require a documented, arm’s-length cost apportionment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 33: Net taxable income before loss carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Derive taxable income after statutory adjustments: add back non-deductible expenditures (e.g., certain fines, excessive director remuneration, non-arms’ length charges) and subtract tax-exempt income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign exchange gains and hedging profits realised through the Taiwan branch should be included; treaty-derived insurance income may be excluded only under a clear permanent-establishment exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter the allowable amount of accumulated tax losses brought forward within the 10-year carryforward limit, conforming to the audited financial statements and prior return schedules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses from a foreign head office may not be set off against the Taiwan branch; only losses incurred by the Taiwan taxpayer (including the JV) are eligible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute the 12% AMT on basic income if preference items exceed the exemption floor. For a captive insurer, the largest preference is the deduction for unearned premium reserve build-up.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident branch must still complete this computation if its Taiwan insurance profits enjoy treaty exemption benefits exceeding the basic-tax threshold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: If accumulated undistributed retained earnings exceed NT$200 million, calculate the 5% surtax unless the excess has been reinvested in qualifying Taiwanese assets or R&D within the statutory spread period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This surtax is a corporate-level levy; non-resident shareholders are not directly assessed, but it is a funding cost on future dividend distributions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Signature of the responsible person / tax agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The JV’s responsible director must sign and seal the return; if the return is prepared by a CPA, the certifying CPA’s seal and tax agent registration number are required.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign directors who reside outside Taiwan must authorise in writing a Taiwan-licensed tax representative to sign the prescribed declarations; the article under which the representative acts must be recorded.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return attracts a surcharge of 3% of the assessed tax for every additional two-day period of delay, capped at 9% of the tax assessed. Unpaid tax bears monthly interest at the Postal Bank one-year fixed rate. Underreported or fraudulent returns subject the taxpayer to a deficiency penalty of two to three times the underpaid tax and, for intentional evasion, criminal prosecution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-seeking Enterprise Income Tax Provisional Tax Return (營利事業所得稅暫繳申報書) — filed through the Ministry of Finance electronic portal or submitted at an authorised bank together with the provisional tax payment.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due by 30 September of the current tax year for calendar-year taxpayers. For an approved non-calendar fiscal year, the provisional return is due within two months after the close of the first half of the fiscal year (i.e., by the end of the eighth month of the taxable year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter one-half of the previous year’s final CIT liability, before refundable credits and after the deduction of applicable investment tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a Taiwan branch of a non-resident foreign insurer, enter one-half of the previous year’s branch CIT liability that was effective connected with Taiwan-source underwriting business.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 02: Actual first-half net income election
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: If the captive SPV has suffered an underwriting loss in the first half of the current year, the taxpayer may elect to compute the provisional tax from actual interim financial statements rather than the prior-year benchmark.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The election must be accompanied by an actuarial and interim audit schedule; the non-resident branch should confirm that the loss computation follows Taiwan GAAP and FSC reserve rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount remitted to the National Treasury as a prepayment of the current year’s CIT. The remittance must be made in New Taiwan dollars and retained as a tax deposit against the year-end tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident branches and JVs must pay through the Taiwan banking system; SWIFT and foreign-currency payments are not accepted as provisional tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to pay the provisional tax on time triggers monthly interest on the shortfall at the statutory rate under Article 111 of the Income Tax Act. In addition, if the provisional tax paid is below 90% of the actual current-year liability, an extra assessment interest charge applies upon finalisation.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% on dividends distributed to non-resident corporate and individual shareholders. Resident Taiwanese corporations are not subject to further withholding under the single-tier regime; the distributing company bears the 5% retained-earnings surtax before dividend declaration.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply for a reduced treaty dividend withholding rate, the non-resident recipient must present a Certificate of Residence (TRC) issued by the home tax authority, complete the Ministry of Finance’s ‘Application for Tax Exemption or Reduced Withholding under a Tax Agreement’, and submit it to the JV before the dividend distribution date. The National Taxation Bureau then issues a ruling confirming the applicable rate (typically 10% for substantial shareholdings and 15% for other portfolio investors). For refunds of excess WHT, the recipient may file a refund claim with the local tax bureau within five years of the dividend payment. No bilateral DTA relief exists in respect of Mainland China tax residents because Taiwan does not apply a tax treaty with China: dividends paid to a Chinese parent are withheld at the full 21% statutory rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest payments to non-residents for offshore loans attract 15% withholding (or 15% also serves as the effective treaty ceiling under several DTAs). Royalty payments for trademarks, patents and know-how used in Taiwan attract 20% withholding; most Taiwan DTAs lower this to 10%, but no treaty relief applies to royalties paid to Mainland Chinese entities. For payments to a Chinese parent, there is no treaty reduction: interest is withheld at 15% and royalties at 20%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: NT$200,000,000 in annual related-party transactions (aggregate sales, purchases, services, fees, and interest) triggers a mandatory contemporaneous Transfer Pricing Report (Local File). For intangibles alone, a NT$100,000,000 threshold applies. A Master File and Country-by-Country Report are required when the ultimate MNE group’s consolidated annual revenue exceeds NT$50,000,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not have a separate Economic Substance Regulations statute, but the GAAR of Article 43-1 of the Income Tax Act and the FSC insurance licensing framework jointly require a captive reinsurance SPV to maintain real commercial substance. The SPV must operate from a physical Taiwan office, employ locally-based underwriters and claims personnel, maintain arm’s-length risk-based capitalisation, and ensure that all board decisions and policy assumptions are made in Taiwan. A paper SPV that does not bear actual insurance risk, lacks adequate records, or serves as a pure booking vehicle for a multinational group will be disregarded for tax purposes, with its income recharacterised in the hands of the ultimate insured/parent group.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Underreporting of TX Reinsurance Income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underreporting assumed reinsurance premiums, artificially inflating ceded reinsurance expenses, using back-to-back offshore transactions to strip profit to a zero-tax affiliate, or failing to record mandatory unearned premium reserve reversals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 110 of the Income Tax Act, the taxpayer is ordered to make good the tax shortfall and is fined two to three times the underpaid tax. Tax Collection Act Article 41 imposes criminal liability in cases of intentional evasion, resulting in imprisonment for up to five years, a fine, and irrevocable seizure of assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The responsible director and finance officers are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax if the JV is found to be a sham; travel bans and asset freezes are issued under Article 25 of the Tax Collection Act; criminal directors face loss of liberty.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell SPV / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A Taiwan captive reinsurance SPV with no physical office, no hired actuaries or insurance risk managers, no Taiwan-based board meetings, or where the parent group makes underwriting and claims decisions without local authorisation; operating as a brass-plate booking centre.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority applies Article 43-1 GAAR to recompute income as if the arrangement were not contractual; deficiency penalty up to three times evaded tax; FSC revocation of the captive insurer’s license under the Insurance Act; unlawful operation is punishable by administrative fines and the dissolution of the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for corporate dissolution costs, restitution of improperly paid dividends, and regulatory penalties; criminal liability can arise if the shell company was used to defraud creditors or tax authorities, and directors may be disqualified from all financial industry roles for up to five years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to perform customer due diligence on ultimate beneficial owners of the captive programme, absence of suspicious transaction reporting on circular premium flows or fraudulent claims, and using non-compliant remitted intercompany funds routed via Sanctioned jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Control Act, administrative fines up to NT$10,000,000 may be imposed for each serious compliance breach; criminal money laundering is punishable by imprisonment for one to seven years and a fine of up to NT$30,000,000; the Financial Supervisory Commission can suspend the entity’s authorised business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The compliance director and each board member who knowingly effected or acquiesced in the laundering structure may be prosecuted criminally, fined personally, stripped of their directorship, and banned from holding any appointment in an insurance, bank, or capital-market enterprise.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or maintain a contemporaneous TP report for related-party reinsurance transactions above the NT$200 million threshold; ignoring Master File / CbC reporting duty in MNE groups exceeding NT$50 billion; applying artificially interposed reinsurance intermediaries that do not carry economically significant risk.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The National Taxation Bureau may adjust the captive SPV’s taxable income using a deemed arm’s-length pricing method; the underpaid tax is subject to a two to three times deficiency penalty. An additional separate fine of NT$30,000 to NT$100,000 per document is levied for each missing schedule. Persistent incompliance is treated as intentional evasion under Article 41.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed inaccurate TP documentation or knowingly disregarded documentation requirements can be jointly liable for the company’s tax deficiency; where insolvency results, a civil suit may succeed against their personal assets, and a travel restriction order may be issued until the assessment is settled.
